name: Poisson 8x8x8: DirectSolver vs. PCG
description:
Single-rank Poisson benchmark on an 8x8x8 cuboid grid comparing PCG with the
cached feectools DirectSolver over repeated solves of the same operator.
slurm_script_str:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/.venv/bin/activate
echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Running profiling case: poisson_direct_vs_pcg_8x8x8 (1 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: Single-rank repeated Poisson solves on an 8x8x8 grid, comparing cached DirectSolver against PCG."
echo "Physics problem: Small manufactured Poisson field solve on a 3D cuboid."
echo "Struphy model used: Poisson"
echo "Case directory: /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175958Z-532b6da4/poisson_direct_vs_pcg_8x8x8"
echo "----------------------------------------"
mkdir -p "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175958Z-532b6da4/poisson_direct_vs_pcg_8x8x8/sim_02"
cp "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/profiling/examples/Poisson/direct_vs_pcg/params_poisson_solver.py" "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175958Z-532b6da4/poisson_direct_vs_pcg_8x8x8/parameters.py"

echo "Running poisson_direct_vs_pcg_8x8x8 with 1 MPI ranks"
cd "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175958Z-532b6da4/poisson_direct_vs_pcg_8x8x8"
mpirun -n 1 /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/.venv/bin/python /home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/profiling/examples/Poisson/direct_vs_pcg/params_poisson_solver.py --id 2 --solver direct --num-elements 8 8 8 --repeats 100 > "/home/maxlinadmin/git_repos/struphy-hub/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260819T175958Z-532b6da4/poisson_direct_vs_pcg_8x8x8/sim_02/struphy.out" 2>&1

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Completed profiling case: poisson_direct_vs_pcg_8x8x8 (1 MPI ranks)"
echo "----------------------------------------"
